nodes.description: Caller-supplied address (msg.sender) used for ownership assignment, onlyOwner gating and as the fallback purchase beneficiary.
owner: address of the contract owner; set in the Ownable constructor and updated by transferOwnership.
paused: boolean emergency-stop flag toggled by pause()/unpause() and checked by whenNotPaused.
totalSupply: public supply counter declared in the ERC20 base and mutated by mint().
balances: mapping(address=>uint) of token balances.
allowed: nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) holding ERC20 allowances.
mintingFinished: flag intended to stop minting, but the canMint modifier was removed from mint().
token: ZilleriumPresaleToken contract deployed by the presale constructor.
wallet: hard-coded fund collection address receiving all raised ether.
weiRaised: total wei collected; incremented in buyTokens and read by validPurchase/hasEnded.
cap: maximum token base units that may be sold before the presale is considered ended.
minInvestment: minimum wei contribution accepted (1e16).
rate: number of tokens issued per wei/ether, used to compute token amounts.
isFinalized: flag set by finalize() to prevent repeated finalization.
contactInformation: free-form owner-controlled metadata string.
SafeMath.mul: multiplication with assert-based overflow check.
SafeMath.add: addition with assert-based overflow check.
SafeMath.sub: subtraction with assert(b <= a) underflow check.
Ownable constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership(address): onlyOwner transfer of ownership, rejects the zero address.
pause(): onlyOwner whenNotPaused, sets paused = true.
unpause(): onlyOwner whenPaused, sets paused = false.
ERC20 balanceOf interface declaration.
ERC20 transfer interface declaration.
ERC20 transferFrom interface declaration.
ERC20 approve interface declaration.
Token payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, blocking direct ether sends.
balanceOf(address): returns balances[_owner].
transfer(address,uint): SafeMath-adjusted move of balances from msg.sender.
transferFrom(address,address,uint): uses inferred local _allowance from allowed[_from][msg.sender] and decrements it.
approve(address,uint): writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
allowance(address,address): reads the allowed mapping.
mint(address,uint256): onlyOwner mint; the canMint modifier was explicitly removed, so minting is possible after finishMinting().
finishMinting(): onlyOwner, sets mintingFinished = true.
allowMinting(): onlyOwner, resets mintingFinished = false, re-opening minting.
createTokenContract(): internal factory deploying a new ZilleriumPresaleToken.
Presale payable fallback: calls buyTokens(msg.sender).
buyTokens(address) payable whenNotPaused: validates purchase, updates weiRaised, mints tokens on the external token contract then forwards funds.
forwardFunds(): internal, sends msg.value to the wallet address using transfer().
validPurchase(): checks msg.value >= minInvestment and weiRaised*rate <= cap.
finalize(): onlyOwner, requires !isFinalized and hasEnded(), calls token.finishMinting().
setContactInformation(string): onlyOwner write of contactInformation.
hasEnded(): returns whether weiRaised*rate >= cap.
External call token.mint(beneficiary, tokens) executed inside buyTokens against a separately deployed contract.
Ether send wallet.transfer(msg.value) executed in forwardFunds after the external mint call.
mint() executes without the mintingFinished/canMint guard, letting the owner mint indefinitely and beyond cap.
Balance/supply arithmetic updates performed on balances, allowed and totalSupply during token transfers and minting.

weiAmount local holding msg.value inside buyTokens.
